name: Babushka
source:
You'll never believe in the mystical unless you've personally encountered it.

Natalia has recently lost her grandmother, who left her a house in a small village. Upon her arrival, the woman learns that there has been some devilry going on in the village for years and it seems her grandmother is clearly involved.

Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2678]Anivisual[/url]
translation:
除非你亲自经历过，否则你永远不会相信神秘的事物。

娜塔莉亚最近失去了她的祖母，她在一个小村庄里给她留下了一所房子。到达后，这名妇女得知村里多年来一直在发生一些邪恶的事情，而且她的祖母显然也参与其中。

翻译自 [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2678]Anivis[/url]
